title: Slack events go missing in production while a developer runs the same app locally in Socket Mode
symptoms: Some events reach the laptop and never reach the deployed app
Production misses about half of slash commands while a local copy is running
refresh_requested or warning disconnects every few hours
cause: Socket Mode allows up to 10 connections per app and Slack sends each payload to any one of them. A local process using the same app token takes a share of production traffic, and every connection is recycled every few hours.
fix: Use a separate Slack app for development, handle reconnects on refresh_requested, and remember Socket Mode apps cannot be listed in the Marketplace.
apply: SLACK_APP_TOKEN for local dev must belong to a separate development app, never the production app
affected: Slack apps using Socket Mode, as of 2026-10
